description.value: Bailey's Pub is a locally owned neighbourhood pub in North Kamloops serving scratch-made Canadian food for breakfast, lunch, and dinner seven days a week. The casual, welcoming atmosphere caters to groups of any size, with walk-ins accepted alongside reservations. Touring cyclists will find a full-service meal stop with takeout available and regular entertainment including karaoke and trivia nights.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms an active, locally-owned pub at 1050 8th St, Kamloops with scratch-made food and takeout service explicitly stated ('take-out service is available as well'). OSM had no phone listed; the website supplies 250-376-3193 and a matching address with postal code. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or dietary option information appears anywhere in the website text or OSM tags, so those fields remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
